name: Assetto Corsa
description: Assetto Corsa (2014): the LapLogger in-game Python app, track and car pictures from your AC install, AC's AI line and saved best laps.

steps: Run logger/install_ac_app.bat once: it links assettocorsa/apps/python/LapLogger to logger/LapLogger and saves laps to data/ac.
Enable the app once in AC: Settings > General > UI Modules > LapLogger.
Start a new driving session after updating the app.

ui.empty_hint: the LapLogger app in Assetto Corsa
ui.picture_hint: (optional: AC's own picture is used otherwise)

notes.track_status: Legacy AC track validity is unverified.

handbrake.text: AC can't, so there it counts rear-wheel lock-ups with the brake pedal off.

provenance.slide angle: derived from the car's local velocity (logger 1.3+)
provenance.handbrake: proxy: rear-wheel lock-ups with the brake pedal off (AC doesn't report the handbrake)
provenance.valid: game invalid flags plus independently observed >2 tyres outside; observed-clear is not game certification, legacy validity is unverified
provenance.input device: AC's own input setting (cfg/controls.ini INPUT_METHOD) at session start; older laps tagged by hand
